name: Kannou Kyoushuu
source:
Grandfather summons main hero to announce that in order to get inheritance he has to teach several maidens various sex techniques during a month. But it's so easy to fall in love with one of them...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-march-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
祖父把主人公叫到身边，宣布他若想继承遗产，就必须在一个月内向几名少女传授各种性爱技巧。然而，在相处过程中，实在太容易爱上其中某个人了……

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-march-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
